output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.net_revenue), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Average net revenue per order for orders dated in calendar year 2025, counting only orders flagged as revenue (is_revenue). Order value here means net_revenue, so shipping fees are not added.
